mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 110 signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with INDPRO > 110.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month RSAFS growth rate exceeding 10% YoY indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with RSAFS YoY growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase over a 2-month period, the dual signal predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to tightening monetary conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase over 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increasing.

mechanism_narrative: An UNRATE increase of more than 0.5pp over 2 months signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE increase > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 1000 signals decreased housing market activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with HOUST < 1000.
